title: THE DOWNED TIMER GETS ITS OWN CENTRED ROW
why: Critic on screen 34: the timer was pushed to the edge of the plate and the block was off-centre. The timer now sits centred under the word down, the bar and the prompt follow in one column, and the plate is 480 wide.
now: When you are down, the timer now sits centred under the word down and everything stacks in one column.

edits.replacement: var _tmY=_dy+Math.round(_hH*1.05), _barY=_dy+Math.round(_hH*0.42)+Math.round(_hH*1.05);   // v28.xx (cw-downplate2): the timer has its own row under the word down, centred

edits.anchor: ctx.textAlign='left';   // v28.xx (cw-downplate): the timer is the hero, as big as the word down
edits.replacement: ctx.textAlign='center';   // v28.xx (cw-downplate2): one centred column (critic on screen 34: the timer was pushed to the plate edge)
